name: AR_CONFIRMATION_ACTIONS
description: This table stores information about which action to take based on the information that is included in a trading partner's confirmation message. Each row includes general information such as status, reason code, and corresponding action. Each row represents an action that corresponds to a specific combination of status and reason code that was included in a trading partner's confirmation message.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of document transferred. Determined by trading partner.

columns.name: REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason code of document transferred. Determined by trading partner.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: HANDLER_NAME
columns.description: Handler that handles the appropriate action for this combination of STATUS and REASON_CODE

columns.name: HANDLER_TYPE
columns.description: Handler type of the handler that handles the appropriate action for this combination of STATUS and REASON_CODE

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
